description: Chunking methods compared on SQuAD and ConditionalQA, with the README's fixed pipeline: no augmentation, bge-m3, hybrid retrieval, no reranking. Markdown and HTML methods run only on datasets with that rendering. Run: .venv\Scripts\python.exe experiments.py experiments/chunking_eval_squad_conditionalqa.json

chunk_embedding.description: Over-long chunks (the semantic methods have no upper bound) are cut to bge-m3's limit, counted with its own tokenizer.
